notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Aphetto Alchemist.
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Aphetto Alchemist's ability targeting any other artifact or creature.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and the second target.
Repeat.
